description_en: Queries information about an Object Storage Service (OSS) backup migration task for an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询SQL Server的某个OSS备份上云任务的信息
name: DescribeMigrateTaskById

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup migration task. You can call DescribeMigrateTasks to query the task ID
parameters.help_zh: 备份上云任务的ID，可以通过DescribeMigrateTasks接口查询
parameters.name: migrate_task_id

BackupMode.description_en:
The type of the backup migration task. Valid values:

FULL: The restore operation is performed by using a full backup file.
UPDF: The incremental data is restored by using an incremental backup file or log file
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份数据上云任务类型，取值：

FULL：表示通过全量备份文件去执行还原操作。
UPDF：表示通过增量文件或者日志文件去还原增量部分的数据

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the backup migration task was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 备份数据上云任务创建时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Description.description_en: The description of the backup migration task
Description.description_zh: 备份数据上云任务的描述信息

EndTime.description_en: The time when the backup migration task ended. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 备份数据上云任务结束时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

IsDBReplaced.description_en:
Indicates whether the import is an overwrite import. Valid values: 

False: No.
True: Yes
IsDBReplaced.description_zh:
是否是覆盖性导入。取值： 

False：否
True：是

MigrateTaskId.description_en: The ID of the OSS backup migration task

Status.description_en:
The status of the backup migration task. Valid values:
NoStart: Not started.
Running: Running.
Success: Succeeded.
Failed: Failed.
Waiting: Waiting for incremental backup file import
Status.description_zh:
备份数据上云任务的状态，取值：
NoStart：未开始
Running：运行中
Success：成功
Failed：失败
Waiting：等待增量备份文件导入
